name: software-dev-factory
description: Installs and operates the software development factory, a governed SDLC controller that drives your own Claude Code or Codex CLI through plan, red, green and review against an approved spec, as a folder's agentic function with one git repository per product under projects/; use for "set up the software dev factory here", "make this folder a software factory", "approve a spec", "run the factory", "update my software-dev-factory".
